stem: A team at Driftwood Retail is decommissioning an entire test environment and wants every resource the configuration manages removed, ending in an empty state. Which command fits?
rationale: destroy deprovisions every object the configuration manages and ends in an empty state, matching the requirement directly. apply -auto-approve only carries out whatever a normal plan currently proposes, which for an unchanged configuration proposes nothing to remove. init -backend=false only installs providers and initializes without a backend; it removes nothing. fmt -recursive only rewrites file style across directories and has no effect on infrastructure.
